hints.reply_targets: How many different people they have replied to. Read from their last seven days and their earliest actions.
hints.repeated_text: Share of their replies that repeat text they have already used elsewhere. Read from their last seven days and their earliest actions.
hints.bot_commands: Share of their replies that are nothing but a bot trigger, such as !PIZZA. Read from their last seven days and their earliest actions.
hints.self_replies: Share of their replies written under their own posts rather than other people's. Read from their last seven days and their earliest actions.
hints.self_votes: Share of their votes cast on their own posts. Read from their last seven days and their earliest actions.
hints.ke_score: Lifetime rewards divided by the stake they hold. Being paid for your work and taking the earnings out is normal on Hive; this is the ratio, not a judgement.
hints.active_hive_power: The stake they actually wield: what they own, less what they have delegated to others, plus what others have delegated to them.
hints.delegated_out_percent: How much of their own stake is currently delegated to somebody else.
hints.received_delegation: Whether somebody delegated stake to this account to start with.
hints.created_by: The account that created this one.
hints.votes_on_post: How many people voted on this post.
hints.replies_on_post: How many replies this post has.
hints.stake_mix: Where their Hive Power sits: their own, what they have delegated to others, and what others have delegated to them. The number in the middle is what they actually wield.
hints.stake_kept: Hive Power they own and have not delegated to anyone.
hints.stake_out: Hive Power they own but have delegated to somebody else.
hints.stake_in: Hive Power somebody else has delegated to them.
hints.reply_mix: What their replies are made of: how much repeats text they have used before, how much is only a bot trigger, how much sits under their own posts, and how many of their votes went to themselves. Read from their last seven days and their earliest actions.
hints.flower: Шесть показателей того, как использовался этот аккаунт, по одному на лепесток. Наведите курсор на лепесток, чтобы увидеть, что он считает; в центре — аккаунт, создавший этот.

welcome.name: Приветствие
welcome.body:
Welcome to Hive, @{{name}} — good to see a first post.

Have a look around, follow a few people whose posts you like, and don't worry about getting it right straight away. Plenty of us are still working that out.

Glad you're here.

tips.name: Несколько советов
tips.body:
Welcome aboard, @{{name}}.

Three things that helped me early on:

- Post in a community that fits what you write — your post gets seen by people who care about it.
- Reply to other people's posts. It is the fastest way to meet anybody here.
- Keep your keys somewhere safe and never paste your owner key into anything.

Ask if you get stuck.

question.name: Спросите их
question.body:
